system.description: After failing the initial situation test, the victim forgets their identity and past. Each day they can make a situation test to recover one important memory; each success adds +2 to later daily tests, even after a failure. When the situation value reaches 20, a success restores all memories. The GM decides which skills can be used instinctively and removes the effect when the memories return.
